en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ismail Bin Hammam who said,

‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan Al-Rezaasws saying: ‘Do not pelt the Jamarah on the day of the sacrifice until the emergence of the sun’. And heasws said: ‘You should pelt the Jamarah from the middle of the valley, and you should make each Jamarah to be on your right. Then turn to the other opening when you pelt the Al-Aqabah Jamarah’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ahmad ibn m h has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isma’il ibn Hammam who has said the following:

“I heard al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ’You must not throw pebbles on al-Jamarah al-‘ Aqabah on the day of al-Nahr (slaughtering the offering, 10th of Dhu al-Hajjah) until sunrise.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Throw pebbles on al-Jamar from interior of the valley, keep each one on your right side and turn to the other side when throwing pebbles on Jamarah al-‘Aqabah.’”
